summary: Free-ads tabloid page: a heavy serif 'Classifieds' logo, a grey rounded panel shouting TOTALLY FREE ADS with a starburst, a grey sidebar of how-to-place tabs with clip art, then condensed-sans liners under black FOR SALE bars, and a mail-in coupon grid.

frame.masthead: Small 'Observer' over a huge ultra-bold serif 'Classifieds'; grey strip with URL, phone and deadline in condensed sans.
frame.footer: Coupon: ruled grid of boxes for writing your ad, with 'Details below not for publication'.

headers.notes: Bold condensed caps; repeated at the top of every column.
Rounded black tab with white checkbox and italic brush-script text, paired with line-art clip art (phone, fax, envelope, clock).
Extended black grotesque in mid grey with a hard drop shadow, in a rounded grey panel; starburst FREE badge breaks the corner.

units.example: BARBECUE. 'Beefeater', 2 burner. Never been used. Was $559. $420. Hampton. 9598 6277.
units.notes: Item name in bold condensed caps with a full stop, condensed body, price, suburb, phone. A hairline and a tiny booking code (XZDE★) separate each ad.

units.example: Categories appear in alphabetical order and include: ● Business Opportunities ● Church Notices...
units.notes: Boxed bullet list explaining the order of classifications.
Dashed border, huge extended black caps, cartoon man running with a newspaper (only colour on the page).

type.look: Ultra-bold soft serif (Cheltenham Ultra / Clarendon Black)
Helvetica Condensed / Franklin Gothic Condensed body
Italic brush script for how-to tabs

notes: The hairline-plus-code separator between liners is a distinctive rhythm worth a token.
